notes.title: Patch Notes - Fixed the Weird Card Thing + More (steam page genre updated)
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone, just pushed fixes for several bugs that were affecting gameplay:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]✅ Fixed Input Control Issues[/b][/p][p]  - Keyboard input is now properly blocked during upgrade selection screens - no more accidental[/p][p]  unfreezing![/p][p]  - Escape key no longer disrupts game over cinematics or upgrade panels[/p][p]  - Game remains properly frozen during all UI interactions[/p][p]  [b]✅ Fixed Second Turret Upgrade[/b][/p][p]  - Second turret skill now spawns correctly when selected[/p][p]  - Added robust fallback system to find turret references[/p][p]  [b]✅ Fixed Upgrade Progression[/b][/p][p]  - Level 2 upgrades no longer appear without selecting Level 1 first[/p][p]  - Enforced proper tier progression (I → II → III)[/p][p]  [b]✅ Game Over State Protection[/b][/p][p]  - ALL keyboard shortcuts disabled after game over until restart[/p][p]  - No more spacebar unfreezing after death[/p][p]  - Game over sequence plays uninterrupted[/p][p]  [b]✅ Removed Conflicting Controls[/b][/p][p]  - Cleaned up hardcoded spacebar shortcuts[/p][p]  [b]✅ Fixed that weird card bug[/b][/p][p]  - Upgrade cards would get HUGE if the mouse was over during the initial animation.[/p][p]  - Cards should animate in smoothly no matter where your cursor is[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for your patience while I worked through these issues.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i](Please let me know in the comments if you encounter other bugs or still encounter those bugs I mentioned)[/i][/p]

tags.bug: ✅ Fixed Input Control Issues
- Keyboard input is now properly blocked during upgrade selection screens - no more accidental
unfreezing!
- Escape key no longer disrupts game over cinematics or upgrade panels
- Game remains properly frozen during all UI interactions
✅ Fixed Second Turret Upgrade
- Second turret skill now spawns correctly when selected
- Added robust fallback system to find turret references
✅ Fixed Upgrade Progression
- Level 2 upgrades no longer appear without selecting Level 1 first
- Enforced proper tier progression (I → II → III)
✅ Game Over State Protection
- ALL keyboard shortcuts disabled after game over until restart
- No more spacebar unfreezing after death
- Game over sequence plays uninterrupted
✅ Removed Conflicting Controls
- Cleaned up hardcoded spacebar shortcuts
✅ Fixed that weird card bug
- Upgrade cards would get HUGE if the mouse was over during the initial animation.
- Cards should animate in smoothly no matter where your cursor is
